title: Speculm
summary: SPEC'ULM, noun [Latin] 1. A mirror or looking glass. 2. A glass that reflects the images of objects. 3. A metallic reflector used in catadioptric telescopes. 4. In surgery, an instrument for dilating

inlines.v: SPEC'ULM, noun [Latin] 1. A mirror or looking glass. 2. A glass that reflects the images of objects. 3. A metallic reflector used in catadioptric telescopes. 4. In surgery, an instrument for dilating and keeping open certain parts of the body.
